levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Several shopping-list items don't trace back to any planned meal, or several planned meals have no matching items.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The shopping list is clearly derived from the seven days of planned meals.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Staples and perishables are correctly separated in a way that shows genuine understanding of shelf life, not just labeling.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: No comparison is made between the estimated cost and the budget slice.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The estimated cost is compared to the budget slice, and any gap is named.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: A specific, workable change is proposed for closing any gap, rather than a vague 'spend less.'

lookFors: Every one of the seven days has at least a meal type planned, not left blank.
The staples/perishables sort reflects real shelf-life reasoning.
No real prices, real store names tied to a real purchase, or real account details appear.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
